rule_engine.title: Strong 9th House — Higher Learning & Philosophy
rule_engine.astrological_logic: 9th house (Dharma/Higher knowledge) strong → Advanced education, foreign study, philosophical depth
rule_engine.description: Advanced degrees, research, foreign education, or spiritual learning.

rule_engine.title: Strong Lagna — Physical Vitality & Immunity
rule_engine.astrological_logic: 1st house (Lagna/Self) strong → Strong constitution, immunity, and recovery ability
rule_engine.description: Strong immune system, high physical stamina, and quick recovery.

rule_engine.title: Strong Lagna Lord — Physical Constitution Blessed
matched_conditions: Lagna lord Moon with strong Shadbala and favorable dignity
evidence_chain: Lagna lord Moon in Great Friend (Adhi Mitra)
rule_engine.astrological_logic: Lagna lord Moon (body governor) in favorable dignity + strong Shadbala → Constitution protected
rule_engine.description: Well-protected physical constitution; resistance to major ailments.

rule_engine.title: Malefic in 5th — Children Challenges
rule_engine.astrological_logic: Malefics ['Rahu'] in Putra Bhava → Delay, difficulty, or challenges related to children
rule_engine.description: Children may face health challenges or there may be delayed parenthood.

rule_engine.title: Strong 3rd House — Sibling Harmony
rule_engine.astrological_logic: 3rd house (Sahaja/Siblings) strong → Supportive siblings, courage, and communication
rule_engine.description: Good sibling relationships, mutual support, and cooperative endeavors.

rule_engine.title: Strong 9th House — Father's Fortune
rule_engine.astrological_logic: 9th house (Pitru Bhava) strong → Prosperous, long-lived father and ancestral blessings
rule_engine.description: Father's fortune and blessings guide the native's life path.

rule_engine.title: Strong 6th with Malefic — Litigation & Conflict
rule_engine.astrological_logic: 6th house (Shatru/enemies) strong + malefic → Disputes, lawsuits, or conflicts
rule_engine.description: Legal disputes or conflicts are possible; need for legal vigilance.

rule_engine.title: Strong 3rd House — Entrepreneurial Courage
rule_engine.astrological_logic: 3rd house (Parakrama/self-effort, younger siblings) strong → Entrepreneurial boldness
rule_engine.description: Independent business ventures, entrepreneurial spirit, and self-made success.

rule_engine.title: Raja/Mahapurusha Yoga — Exceptional Fame
matched_conditions: Active Raja or Mahapurusha Yoga: Harsha / Sarala Vipareeta Raja Yoga
evidence_chain: Raja/Mahapurusha Yoga active: Harsha / Sarala Vipareeta Raja Yoga
rule_engine.astrological_logic: Active Harsha / Sarala Vipareeta Raja Yoga → Exceptional reputation and fame exceeding ordinary achievement
rule_engine.description: Exceptional public reputation; fame that extends beyond normal professional achievement.
